remarks: Beautifully renovated in spring 2025, this bright and spacious one bedroom one bathroom unit offers modern finishes in a peaceful and well maintained complex. The home features new flooring, updated lighting, fresh paint, bathroom fixtures, and a brand new washer and dryer. The kitchen is appointed with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinet space. The living area is enhanced by an inviting fireplace and oversized windows that bring in abundant natural light, and it opens directly to a private slate and marble patio surrounded by mature trees, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The bedroom is generously sized with ample closet space.  Additional features include a unit garage plus reserved parking, with the homeowner association providing grounds maintenance, trash pickup, snow removal, and property management. Convenient location close to I95, shopping, dining, and pharmacies. South Norwalk train station and Darien train station are both just a short drive away, offering express service to Grand Central in about 60 minutes, making commuting to New York City simple and efficient. This home combines modern comfort, privacy, and convenience, ready for immediate occupancy.
